original_ai_output.title_zh: 卡杜纳州为残障青少年开展性与心理健康宣传
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卡杜纳州初级卫生保健委员会在卡杜纳州特殊教育学校为残障青少年开展性与生殖健康、经期卫生、心理健康及性别暴力预防宣传。活动属国际青少年健康周的一部分，获联合国儿童基金会等发展伙伴支持。

location.site: 卡杜纳州特殊教育学校（KADSSES）

key_facts.fact: 卡杜纳州初级卫生保健委员会为残障青少年开展性与生殖健康、经期卫生、心理健康及性别暴力预防宣传
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kaduna State Primary Health Care Board (SPHCB), has sensitised adolescents with disabilities to sexual and reproductive health, menstrual hygiene, mental health and prevention of gender-based violence.

key_facts.fact: 活动在卡杜纳州特殊教育学校举行，属国际青少年健康周的一部分
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The exercise took place at the Kaduna State Special Education School (KADSSES) on Thursday, as part of the International Adolescent Health Week.

key_facts.fact: 活动获联合国儿童基金会、家庭健康协会等发展伙伴支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It was supported by UNICEF, the Society for Family Health (SFH) and other development partners.

key_facts.fact: 学生反映学校供水不足等设施问题，委员会称将转交相关单位处理
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Zailani acknowledged concerns raised by students over inadequate water supply and other facilities in the school.
